title: Learning ab initio phase-field models
abstract: arXiv:2610.01432v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Simulating microstructure evolution requires quantum-mechanical accuracy and mesoscopic reach in length and time scales, a combination that no current method achieves. Classical phase-field models provide this reach, but their accuracy is limited by phenomenological free energies and mobilities. Here we develop a framework for learning ab initio phase-field models, where the mesoscopic equation is not postulated but derived from a Mori-Zwanzig projection of molecular dynamics onto species-density fields under explicit assumptions. The nonlocal free energy and mobility left unspecified by this equation are parametrized by neural networks and learned from short molecular dynamics trajectories generated with machine-learning interatomic potentials of ab initio accuracy. translated_abstract: 模拟微结构演化需要在长度和时间尺度上同时具备量子力学精度与介观尺度的覆盖范围，这种组合是目前任何方法都无法实现的。经典相场模型能够提供这种尺度覆盖，但其精度受限于唯象的自由能和迁移率。在这里，我们开发了一个学习从头算相场模型的框架，其中介观方程不是通过假设给定的，而是在明确假设条件下，通过将分子动力学进行Mori-Zwanzig投影到组分密度场而推导得到的。该方程中未明确指定的非局部自由能和迁移率由神经网络参数化，并通过具有从头算精度的机器学习原子间势所生成的短分子动力学轨迹进行学习。我们在铁硼熔体以及行星条件下的氢氦混合物上演示了该框架。对于铁硼体系，该模型表明FeB₄处的熔体……（摘要内容至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个从头算相场模型学习框架，通过Mori-Zwanzig投影从分子动力学推导介观方程，并用神经网络参数化非局部自由能和迁移率、从机器学习原子间势生成的短轨迹中学习，从而在介观尺度模拟中实现了从头算级别的精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a framework for learning ab initio phase-field models, in which the mesoscopic equation is derived from a Mori-Zwanzig projection of molecular dynamics, and the nonlocal free energy and mobility are parametrized by neural networks learned from short MD trajectories with ab initio accuracy, achieving quantum-mechanical precision at mesoscopic scales.
